DELETE FROM EDS.DID_IBGLIST WHERE AS_OF_DATE = @Datetoprocess;

INSERT INTO EDS.DID_IBGLIST
(
    AS_OF_DATE
,   FCBS_CUSTOMER_ID
,	BNK_CODE
,	SOURCE_CODE
,	FILE_NAME
,	insert_dttm
)

SELECT 
@Datetoprocess AS AS_OF_DATE
,   FCBS_CUSTOMER_ID
,	left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
,	substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
,	FILE_NAME
,	CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME) as insert_dttm
FROM D360.STG_EDS_DID_IBGLIST
WHERE H = 'D'
